questions.q: How do I book my bridal makeup and hairstyling?
questions.a: Send us your wedding date, getting-ready location, preferred artist and requested services. Our team will review availability and guide you through the next steps.
questions.q_zh: 如何预订新娘化妆和发型服务？
questions.a_zh: 请提供婚礼日期、准备地点、希望预约的化妆师和所需服务。团队将确认档期并协助完成预订。

questions.q: How far in advance should I book?
questions.a: We recommend reaching out as soon as your wedding date is confirmed, especially during peak wedding season.
questions.a_zh: 建议在婚礼日期确定后尽早联系，尤其是婚礼旺季。

questions.q: Can I request a specific artist?
questions.a: You are welcome to request your preferred SCULP artist. Availability depends on your wedding date and selected services.
questions.a_zh: 可以指定希望预约的 SCULP 化妆师，具体取决于婚礼日期和档期。

questions.q: How is my booking confirmed?
questions.a: Your booking is confirmed according to the terms in your booking agreement. An enquiry alone does not reserve your date.
questions.a_zh: 预订以双方确认的协议及相关条件为准。仅提交询盘并不代表档期已锁定。

questions.q: Which bridal package is right for me?
questions.a: Our Bridal Trial, Half Day and Full Day options are designed for different needs. Share your timeline and preferred looks, and we'll help you explore the most suitable option.
questions.q_zh: 应该选择哪个新娘套餐？
questions.a_zh: Bridal Trial、Half Day 和 Full Day 适合不同的婚礼需求。提供时间安排和理想造型后，团队可以协助选择。

questions.q: What is included in the Full Day service?
questions.a: Please refer to our current Full Day service description for coverage and styling arrangements. Your booking details will be confirmed before the event.
questions.q_zh: Full Day 全天服务包含什么？
questions.a_zh: 请参考官网最新 Full Day 服务介绍，具体服务时长和造型安排以预订确认为准。

questions.q: Can I add bridal party or family services?
questions.a: Additional services may be arranged depending on the number of guests, required timing and artist availability.
questions.q_zh: 可以增加伴娘或家人的化妆服务吗？
questions.a_zh: 可以根据人数、时间安排及化妆师档期增加相关服务。

questions.q: Are there any additional charges?
questions.a: Additional charges may apply depending on travel, timing, location or requested services. Applicable charges will be confirmed in your quotation.
questions.a_zh: 交通、时间、地点及附加服务可能产生额外费用，具体以正式报价为准。

questions.q: What happens during a bridal trial?
questions.a: Your trial is an opportunity to explore your preferred makeup and hairstyle, discuss inspiration and refine the details with your artist.
questions.a_zh: 试妆用于探索理想妆发、交流参考风格，并与化妆师调整细节。

questions.q: When should I schedule my bridal trial?
questions.a: We recommend arranging your trial sufficiently ahead of your wedding to allow time for adjustments and planning.
questions.a_zh: 建议在婚礼前留出充分时间，以便沟通、试妆及调整。

questions.q: What should I bring to my trial?
questions.a: Bring inspiration photos, images of your wedding dress and accessories, and any preferences or concerns you would like to discuss.
questions.a_zh: 建议准备妆发参考图、婚纱及配饰照片，以及希望沟通的个人偏好。

questions.q: Can I request a particular makeup style?
questions.a: Absolutely. We encourage you to share inspiration images so your artist can tailor the look to your features and personal style.
questions.a_zh: 当然可以。欢迎提供参考图片，化妆师会结合个人特点和偏好设计造型。

questions.q: Do you provide on-location wedding services?
questions.a: On-location arrangements can be discussed when you enquire. Please share your venue and schedule so we can confirm the options.
questions.a_zh: 可在咨询时沟通上门服务，请提供地点和时间以确认安排。

questions.q: Can I change my makeup or hairstyle during the wedding?
questions.a: Look changes depend on your selected service, coverage and wedding schedule. Please discuss your preferred looks in advance.
questions.q_zh: 婚礼过程中可以更换妆发吗？
questions.a_zh: 是否能够换妆或换发型取决于所选服务、时长和婚礼时间表。

questions.q: How is the wedding-day beauty timeline planned?
questions.a: Our team can coordinate the beauty schedule based on your ceremony time, getting-ready location and the number of people receiving services.
questions.q_zh: 婚礼当天化妆时间如何安排？
questions.a_zh: 团队会结合仪式时间、准备地点和服务人数协调妆发时间安排。

questions.q: What if my wedding-day schedule changes?
questions.a: Please inform our team as early as possible. We will review possible adjustments based on your confirmed booking.
questions.q_zh: 婚礼当天时间发生变化怎么办？
questions.a_zh: 请尽早通知团队，我们将根据已经确认的服务安排评估调整方案。

questions.q: How is the final price determined?
questions.a: Your final quotation reflects your selected artist, services, event schedule, location and any agreed additional arrangements.
questions.a_zh: 最终报价由化妆师、服务项目、时间、地点及额外需求共同决定。

questions.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my booking?
questions.a: Rescheduling and cancellation requests are handled according to the terms agreed upon at booking.
questions.q_zh: 可以改期或取消预订吗？
questions.a_zh: 改期和取消需遵循预订时双方确认的相关条款。

questions.q: Do you accommodate skin sensitivities or allergies?
questions.a: Please inform your artist about known allergies or sensitivities before your appointment so suitable options can be discussed.
questions.q_zh: 皮肤敏感或过敏可以提前沟通吗？
questions.a_zh: 如有已知过敏或敏感问题，请在预约前告知化妆师，以便提前沟通适合的方案。

questions.q: How can I contact SCULP Studio?
questions.a: You can contact our team through the official enquiry form on the SCULP Studio website.
questions.a_zh: 您可以通过 SCULP Studio 官网询盘表单联系团队。
